title: Self-Healing CI/CD Evidence Contract
description: Normalized, machine-readable evidence produced by an event adapter / evidence collector and consumed by the deterministic classifier, policy engine, and remediation agent. See docs/evidence-contract.md for the full description.

event_source.description: Identifier of the adapter that produced this evidence, e.g. 'unit-test-adapter'.

repository.description: owner/repo of the repository the event occurred in.

branch.description: The temporary demo branch the failure was observed on.

workflow_run.description: Identifier or URL of the workflow run that generated this evidence.

diff_file.description: Path to a normalized, size-limited diff file relative to the evidence directory.

failure_signature.description: Stable, deterministic identifier used for classification and escalation de-duplication.

concise_log_file.description: Path to a normalized, size-limited log excerpt relative to the evidence directory. Full raw logs are never passed to the agent.

relevant_files.description: The minimal set of files the remediation agent is permitted to inspect/modify, subject to policy.

measurements.description: Scenario-specific structured measurements (e.g. coverage percent, benchmark timings). Free-form but must be JSON-serializable and small.

attempt_number.description: 1 for the first and only permitted remediation attempt. The policy engine rejects attempt_number > 1.
